description: Hen lysozyme (1AKI) via OpenMM (amber14 + tip3p), minimized + 10ps NVT. Second MD engine through the same adapter; better-equilibrated than the 30ps GROMACS run. The committed energy.xvg carries only a 'Potential' column; since IO-002 removed the positional first-column fallback, the conserved-energy metric is not computable from this fixture and is not asserted. Metrics regenerated 2026-09-12 from the committed fixture under ORA-003 (identity-pinned inputs; the previous values were computed by an older MDAnalysis DCD reader).
name: lysozyme_openmm
